note: Listed entities whose crypto addresses are traced on chain by casefold/fetch_chain.py: the latest transfers of each address (hop 1) and, for the largest counterparties, their latest transfers (hop 2). Public block explorers only, no keys. A spread of typologies: exchanges in cases (Garantex, Grinex), OTC desks laundering ransomware (SUEX, Chatex), state theft (Lazarus Group), a mixer (Blender.io), a scam marketplace (Xinbi Guarantee) and terrorist financing (Gaza Now, Ansarallah).
